items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: He regular trumpet player, Ernie Coycault was just a straight man, he didn't play hot jazz, and he wanted me to play the hot chords.

ctx.x: Sonny Clay came up to me and said that he was going to make some records and he wanted to know if I would mind playing on it. I told him yes, and so he was going to record two numbers, one on each side and he wanted me to play the hot cords
along with the rest of the band, the band was going to back me up. He regular trumpet player, Ernie Coycault was just a straight man, he didn't play hot jazz, and he wanted me to play the hot chords.
Also, Sonny wanted me to rehearse with him because he was expecting to enlarge his band and if he added another trumpet he was going to put me on, but that did never come around.
